premise: On a wet day Pinecone keeps her scales shut tight and Squirrel and Bird wonder what she is hiding; when the sun comes out she opens, and her secret flies away on tiny wings.
inspiration: Kipling Just So wonder at a real thing (pinecones open in dry air and release winged seeds), turned: patience, not prying, reveals the secret.
lesson: Some secrets open by themselves if you wait.

en-US.title: Pinecone's Secret
en-US.text: {tree:sway loop 0.3} Drizzle, drizzle. Pinecone sat under the tree with all her scales closed tight. Squirrel {squirrel:hop x2} bounced up. What's in there? A secret, said Pinecone. Bird {bird:hop} landed next to her. Is it a nut? Pinecone {pinecone:wobble} shook her head. Is it a beetle? said Squirrel. Is it a very small song? said Bird. Pinecone just smiled, tight as a fist. Everybody waited. Drizzle, drizzle, drizzle. Then, stop. The sun came out, warm and yellow. And Pinecone went... {pinecone:pulse} crick. Crick. Crick, crick, crick! One by one, {pinecone:pulse x3 0.8} her scales opened, like a hundred tiny doors. And out of every door {pinecone:sparkle 0.9} floated a seed with a little papery wing, spinning, spinning, off across the forest. Oh! said Squirrel. Oh! said Bird. That's the secret, said Pinecone. Next spring, go and see where they landed.

es-ES.title: El secreto de Piña
es-ES.text: {tree:sway loop 0.3} Chispea, chispea. Piña estaba bajo el árbol con todas sus escamas bien cerradas. Ardilla {squirrel:hop x2} llegó a brincos. ¿Qué hay ahí dentro? Un secreto, dijo Piña. Pájaro {bird:hop} se posó a su lado. ¿Es una nuez? Piña {pinecone:wobble} dijo que no. ¿Es un escarabajo?, dijo Ardilla. ¿Es una canción muy pequeña?, dijo Pájaro. Piña solo sonreía, cerrada como un puño. Todos esperaron. Chispea, chispea, chispea. Y de pronto, paró. Salió el sol, cálido y amarillo. Y Piña hizo... {pinecone:pulse} cric. Cric. ¡Cric, cric, cric! Una a una, {pinecone:pulse x3 0.8} sus escamas se abrieron, como cien puertecitas. Y de cada puerta {pinecone:sparkle 0.9} salió flotando una semilla con un ala de papel, girando, girando, por todo el bosque. ¡Oh!, dijo Ardilla. ¡Oh!, dijo Pájaro. Ese es el secreto, dijo Piña. En primavera, id a ver dónde han caído.

sound.note: tiny dry clicks, then a cascade of them
